tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search Animal Math's free printables (worksheet packs, unit tests, exit tickets, lesson plans), worksheet makers, quizzes and teaching tools for Pre-K to 5th grade by topic words, grade, kind or a standard code. Each result has its page link and its set item for make_set_link; quizzes list their lev

tools.name: get_maker_settings
tools.description: Every setting of one Animal Math worksheet maker, with its values and default, for build_maker_link. A maker draws new worksheets every time (find makers with search_resources, kind maker).

tools.name: build_maker_link
tools.description: A checked link that opens an Animal Math worksheet maker set up with the given settings, the settings in words, and anything it could not use. Also gives the maker's set item, to put it in a set with make_set_link.

tools.name: get_curriculum
tools.description: Animal Math's free full-year math curricula, kindergarten to 5th grade. Without a grade: the list. With a grade: its units and lessons by number (every lesson has a lesson plan, an exit ticket and practice). With a unit too: that unit's lessons in detail and its pre-check, review and test.

tools.name: get_lesson
tools.description: What one curriculum lesson uses: its goal, its lesson plan page, and the worksheets, maker settings, tool, quiz and exit ticket its plan names, each with its link. To give a teacher the whole lesson in one link, pass its set item to make_set_link.

tools.name: make_set_link
tools.description: One short link (animalmath.com/s/<code>) to a set of Animal Math resources: printables (or some of their pages), makers set up, quizzes at a level, tools and whole curriculum lessons, split into days if wanted. The set page shows them all and makes one PDF of the printables. Checked here: items not
